o: Mickey and his pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse they know and love for all-new adventures filled with games, songs, laughs, and of course, handy helping. Devoted fans will also find surprises in store for them, including a new upper level called the Laughing Loft, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy get their very own clubhouses, and an adorable new friend Little Helper. Mickey's trusted…

eps.o: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!
When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!
Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.
Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.
Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!
Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.
Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.
The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.
Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.
Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.
Daisy's pals get tea to help her lost voice heal.
When the Clubhouse is busy, Minnie can't use the kitchen or Anywhere Areas. Mickey surprises her with her own pink Clubhouse, thanks to Von Drake's invention.
Go-Getters use gadgets to find the missing ice cream.
Mickey and pals take photos for a gallery wall.
Mouseketools help fix gopher holes.
Mickey's pals surprise him at Friendship Lake camp.
Mickey helps Martians build their own clubhouse.
When Martian Mickey crash-lands on Earth, Mickey and pals help him repair his spaceship so he can safely return home.
Minnie organises a rubber duck parade on the lake. When Goofy's duck goes missing, the Sensational Six dive into the water with Mouse Tools to find it.
Gang helps a robot dog learn to play with Pluto.
Mickey and pals help Pete at his movie theater.
Mickey and pals search for Donald's lost toy lion.
The pals dive to find Daisy's pearls with Sea Queen.
Mickey guides Daisylocks home.
A tea party is disrupted by a dragon.
The pals try to stay awake for the meteor shower.
Mickey and pals help Donald get a good night's sleep.
Pals gather candy to fix Wizard Pete's candy cottage.
